items.title: Block Camo 2
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Hide and seek with these epic block camo skins! Which block will you choose to hide with?

- Each skin looks similar to real blocks found in the overworld.
- Fun to use online or in a single player world

items.title: Anime Teens!
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Want to look like an Anime Character? Check out these awesome Anime Style Skins!

+ 8 HD Anime Teens Skins
+ Roleplay
+ By KA Studios

items.title: Neon Demons
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Check out these demons that glow bright in the dark! Be trendy, be fashionable and most importantly, be neon! Choose your favorite among an assortment of 10 different ghoulish teen skins!

- Includes horns and some edgy modern outfits!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Rainbow Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Faster than light, this spectrum of colorful horrors are ripping through the sky! They flash and they glimmer in all manner of colors, but don't be dazzled by their display! Prepare yourself to fight these monsters!

- Includes fourteen colorful rainbow glitch skins!
- Are you lucky enough to see them and survive?

items.title: Masks in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These anonymous crime lords are here to heist in style! Can you get the gold or diamond block and escape without scuffing your suit? Are you lucky enough to evade detection and traps while still styling?

- Includes ten masked robbers in suits skins!
- The sky is the limit for a person in a suit!

items.title: MASKED UP
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Hide your expressions with these epic masked skin outfits. Includes multiple mask emotions!

items.title: Rich Drip
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Flex your style with the Rich Drip skins!

*Modern teen clothing
*Great for roleplaying

items.title: Neons
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Get ready for a night on the town with these glowing neons and be the brightest, most colourful spark in the room.

- 20 skins

items.title: Secret Mountain Refuge
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Explore and make your house this amazing Secret Mountain Refuge

items.title: Block Camo
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
This camo pack includes 20 skins! Do you want to masquerade as a block or a ore? This 'Block Camo' skin pack will make sure you can blend into your Minecraft world.

This skin pack works really well with any hide and seek map.

By: ChewMingo

items.title: Dark Corps
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Join the dark corporation with Dark Corps!

-12 dark anime skins

items.title: Vanilla Biomes
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Do you explore a lot? Roleplay in the proper attire for each biome!

+ 10 biome themed skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Super Rich Mansion
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Acquire this expensive mansion and show your wealth, you can fly over the world with an amazing helicopter and enjoy a comfortable mansion. What are you waiting for?

+1 Helicopter
+2 skins
+Rich Mansion with one amazing pool
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Animal Outfits
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These cute animal outfits are perfect for anyone who wants to express themselves! Go to your next Minecraft adventure with style!

+ Includes 10 animal themed skins

items.title: Cave People
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Cave People are here! These cave men and women have been stuck in a cave for many years. Choose any of these funny cave outfits for your next Minecraft adventure!

+ Cave skins
+ Action
+ Cute

items.title: Undead Horror
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
If you still don't believe in ghosts and spirits, then you better think twice when you take a look at these undead horror skins! Pick your favorite undead monster and give your friends a fright!

- 10 scary skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Power Crowns
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Let everyone know who rules the world with the 'Power Crowns' skin set! Pick the color and design that suits you best!

- 8 unique skins!
- These crowns are perfect for any king or queen!

items.title: Ancient Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Fight for your survival, gather resources and experience a unique Minecraft adventure, with this roman spin on the classic mini-game! Temples and a colosseum await you! Start your survival adventure today with ancient skyblock!

- Skyblock mini-game
- By Rareloot

items.title: Dungeon Crawlers
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
In the deepest, dingiest caves lives an ominous bunch of creatures called Dungeon Crawlers. They can be a menacing crew, but now you and your friends can take control of these frightening monsters. You too can look as if you have crawled out of Earth's depths by roleplaying as one of these 10 horrifying skins.

- 2 free skins included

items.title: Skyblock Giant Chests
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
What do you think will be in these big chests? Find out in Giant Chests Skyblock! But think carefully about how you use the resources of this world, there are not many of them. Equip yourself and get ready to fight the Ender Dragon!

+By FALL Studios

items.title: Town Life
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Grab a cool car, find a nice house and get ready for life in the town! 

+Many houses waiting to be furnished
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Lucky Block Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You like Lucky Blocks? You enjoy playing Skyblock? This map combines both!
Start with nothing, explore the different islands and test your luck. Will you be able to defeat the Ender Dragon?

+300 different outcomes
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Skyblock Classic
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock like everyone loves it!
Build from island to island and think carefully about how to use the few resources. Can you defeat the Ender Dragon? 

- Single and multiplayer friendly!
items.changelog:
- Updated the world to version 26.30
- Added new islands, biomes and better loot!

items.title: Stealthy Ninjas
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Are you sneaky? Roleplay as a stealthy ninja with this epic skin pack!

+ 10 ninja skins!
+ Ultra sneaky!
